subject: Mobile Development
title: Smartphones as Protest Tools
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Smartphones as Protest Tools.

hook.text: The Arab Spring, Hong Kong protests, and BLM were all organized and filmed on smartphones.

buildup.text: Live video streaming turns every citizen into a journalist. Evidence can't be hidden.

discovery.text: Encrypted messaging apps let protesters coordinate while evading government surveillance.

twist.text: Governments responded by shutting down mobile internet during protests.

climax.text: The smartphone is both a tool of liberation and a target for authoritarian control.

punchline.text: The phone is the modern protest sign.

quiz.question: How do governments counter smartphone-powered protests?
